observedPolicy.usingExpression: is_published = true AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (language = 'es'::text OR language = quata_requested_official_post_language()) OR auth.role() = 'authenticated'::text AND (profile_id = quata_current_profile_id() OR quata_current_profile_is_admin())

guarantees.tls: verify-full with the configured pooler CA

limits: This proves the current policy semantics, not historical execution of the file.
PostgreSQL stores policy roles as an OID array whose order does not affect membership semantics; the audit compares the sorted role-name set.
The isolated replay changed only the policy OID and ordered role-OID array while preserving the normalized policy definition and all application-data digests.
Any future change to the policy command, permissiveness, roles, USING expression or WITH CHECK expression requires a new observation before reusing this decision.
